steps.hardClue: Restore power, then defeat the ritual leader to unlock Pack-a-Punch.
steps.clue: Restore power, then defeat the Disciple at Checkpoint Charlie to unlock Pack-a-Punch.

steps.hardClue: Activate and upgrade the robot, then obtain the Wonder Weapon.
steps.clue: Activate and upgrade Klaus, then obtain the CRBR-S.

steps.hardClue: Have the robot break the wall, then melt the metal barrier with a weapon variant.
steps.clue: Use Klaus and the CRBR-S Blazer to open the Secret Lab.

steps.hardClue: Charge three canisters with electrical enemies and return them to the conversion unit.
steps.clue: Charge three canisters with Tempest essence and return them to the Conversion Unit.

steps.hardClue: Position the upgraded robot on the tracks.
steps.clue: Use upgraded Klaus to stop the train.

steps.hardClue: Recover a warhead and keycard from the train, then activate the satellite.
steps.clue: Recover the Warhead and Rico’s Keycard, then activate the Disruptor Satellite.

steps.hardClue: Defeat the priority target and use its uranium to craft two devices.
steps.clue: Defeat the HVT Megaton and use its uranium to craft two Uranium Devices.

steps.hardClue: Collide the two devices on the zipline, insert the result into the warhead, then repeat.
steps.clue: Collide the Uranium Devices on the zipline, insert the Cleansed Rock into the Warhead, then repeat.

steps.hardClue: Defeat the boss, then defend your ally as he carries the warhead into the portal.
steps.clue: Defeat Valentina, then defend Klaus as he carries the Warhead into the portal.
